powers.quote: Such local laws may provide that any taxes imposed shall be paid by the person liable therefor to the owner of the room for hire in the tourist home, inn, club, hotel, motel or other similar place of public accommodation
powers.law_title: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the village of Weedsport

powers.action_summary: Provide in local laws for filing returns and paying the tax on a monthly or other periodic basis.
powers.quote: Such local laws may provide for the filing of returns and the payment of the taxes on a monthly basis or on the basis of any longer or shorter period of time.
powers.law_title: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the village of Weedsport

powers.action_summary: Continue the commissioner's authority to redeploy excess reserves of certain not-for-profit managed care organizations through August 1, 2025.
powers.citation: Section 2 of subpart B of part FFF of chapter 59 of the laws of 2018 (Section 1 of the act)
powers.quote: This act shall take effect August 1, 2018 and shall expire and be deemed repealed August 1, 2025, but, shall not apply to any entity or any subsidiary or affiliate of such entity that disposes of all or a material portion of its assets pursuant to a transaction that:
powers.law_title: Extends provisions of the public health law related to the redeployment of excess reserves of certain not-for-profit managed care organizations

powers.actor_raw: the town of Cortlandt, in the county of Westchester
powers.action_summary: Adopt and amend local laws imposing an occupancy tax of up to three percent on hotel rooms.
powers.quote: the town of Cortlandt, in the county of Westchester, is hereby authorized and empowered to adopt and amend local laws imposing in such town a tax, in addition to any other tax authorized and imposed pursuant to this article
powers.law_title: Authorizes the town of Cortlandt, in the county of Westchester, to levy an occupancy tax

powers.actor_raw: the chief fiscal officer of the town of Cortlandt
powers.action_summary: Collect and administer the occupancy tax.
powers.quote: Such taxes may be collected and administered by the chief fiscal officer of the town of Cortlandt by such means and in such manner as other taxes which are now collected and administered by such officer
powers.law_title: Authorizes the town of Cortlandt, in the county of Westchester, to levy an occupancy tax

powers.action_summary: Promulgate regulations necessary to carry out the mandatory overtime oversight provisions, in consultation with the commissioner of health.
powers.quote: The commissioner, in consultation with the commissioner of health, shall have the authority to promulgate any regulations necessary to carry out the provisions of this section.
powers.law_title: Relates to the restrictions on consecutive hours of work for nurses

powers.action_summary: Assess a civil penalty of up to $1,000 for a first violation, $2,000 for a second violation within twelve months, and $3,000 for a third or later violation.
powers.quote: The commissioner may assess the employer a civil penalty in an amount not to exceed one thousand dollars for a first violation, two thousand dollars for a second violation if within twelve months
powers.law_title: Relates to the restrictions on consecutive hours of work for nurses

powers.action_summary: Assess a civil penalty of up to $500 for a violation of the employer notice and reporting requirements.
powers.quote: provided, however, that the department may assess an employer a civil penalty of not more than five hundred dollars for any violation of paragraph b of subdivision five of this section
powers.law_title: Relates to the restrictions on consecutive hours of work for nurses

powers.action_summary: Impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax through December 31, 2025 by adopting or amending local laws, ordinances or resolutions.
powers.quote: the city of New Rochelle is hereby further authorized and empowered to adopt and amend local laws, ordinances or resolutions imposing such taxes at a rate which is one percent additional to the three percent rate authorized above in this paragraph for such city for the period beginning September first, nineteen hundred ninety-three and ending December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-five
powers.law_title: Extends the authorization of the city of New Rochelle to impose an additional sales and compensating use tax

powers.actor_raw: the assessor of the town of Smithtown
powers.action_summary: Accept an application from Saint James Evangelical Lutheran Church for a real property tax exemption for the 2023-2024 assessment roll.
powers.quote: the assessor of the town of Smithtown, county of Suffolk is hereby authorized to accept from the Saint James Evangelical Lutheran Church of Saint James Long Island NY an application for exemption from real property taxes pursuant to section 462 of the real property tax law
powers.law_title: Authorizes the Saint James Evangelical Lutheran Church of Saint James Long Island NY receive retroactive real property tax exempt status

powers.action_summary: Make appropriate correction to the subject roll, upon approval by the Smithtown town board, if the church would otherwise be entitled to the exemption.
powers.quote: the assessor, upon approval by the Smithtown town board, may make appropriate correction to the subject roll.
powers.law_title: Authorizes the Saint James Evangelical Lutheran Church of Saint James Long Island NY receive retroactive real property tax exempt status

powers.actor_raw: the applicable governing body or tax department
powers.action_summary: Refund taxes paid and cancel unpaid taxes, fines, penalties, liens or interest if the exemption is granted.
powers.quote: the applicable governing body or tax department may, in its sole discretion, provide for the refund of those taxes paid and cancel those taxes, fines, penalties, liens or interest remaining unpaid.
powers.law_title: Authorizes the Saint James Evangelical Lutheran Church of Saint James Long Island NY receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
